body:
What we decided so far:

* add an .ais-InstantSearch\_\_root class name on the main container
* set a default font-family on .ais-InstantSearch\_\_root (sans serif, more?)
* style the default highliting class names so highliting looks good by default
* add some CSS to the getting started tutorial so that if a user follows it, the products are looking good by default

Thanks @bobylito for bringing that up, details like that are key to a great experience
